HTTP 搜索保留 list/totalSize 及原音乐模型字段。

-- request --
POST /music/search
{
  "source": "qq",
  "keyword": "keyword",
  "pageIndex": 1,
  "pageSize": 10
}

-- response --
200
{
  "list": [
    {
      "id": "searched",
      "name": "keyword",
      "artist": "",
      "album": "",
      "duration": 1000,
      "cover": "",
      "source": 0
    }
  ],
  "totalSize": 1
}
